⚙️ Weather API Settings

✅ Live weather data from Open-Meteo — free, no API key required. If the live feed is ever unreachable, the dashboard automatically falls back to estimated conditions so it stays usable.

Settings are saved locally in your browser using localStorage. Weather data is provided by Open-Meteo.

📣 To update the live notice everyone sees (class suspension announcements and PAGASA advisories), submit the Google Form below. Anyone viewing this dashboard — on any device — will see the update within about a minute, no need to touch this Settings panel.
📝 Open the Live Update Form

📢 Official Announcement (local preview only — not shared). This only shows on your own device/browser; use the Google Form above for an update everyone can see. Use this only to preview how an announcement will look, or as an offline fallback if the live Form/Sheet is unreachable.
🌦️ PAGASA Advisory Note (local preview only — not shared). Same as above: this only shows on your own device. Use the Google Form for a note everyone sees.
Per PAGASA's own priority rule, an official level here will always escalate the dashboard's displayed level to at least this — it only ever raises it, never silently lowers it below what live conditions already show.

🗺️ Flood Hazard Susceptibility (UP NOAH)

Static geohazard reference data from UP NOAH's Know Your Hazards tool — not live weather, so it won't auto-update. Look up this location there and enter the three levels shown.

Barangay Warning Map — City of Balanga
Shows all 25 barangays of Balanga City. The marker color is the current live weather-based warning level — that part is still one citywide reading (this dashboard pulls one weather station's worth of data), so every marker shares it. Tap a marker, though, and the popup shows that barangay's actual flood hazard susceptibility (5-yr/25-yr/100-yr return periods) — that part is real per-barangay data, from DOST/UP-NOAH flood hazard shapefiles. Toggle "Show 100-yr flood hazard zones" above to see the hazard areas directly on the map.
